bullets: WiFi‑Enabled Intelligent Control – Let the AlorAir 70‑pint crawl space dehumidifier’s WiFi app put remote management at your fingertips. Check live humidity, fine‑tune settings, and monitor operation progress from anywhere – so your crawl space stays protected even when you're away. Smart remote access means effortless, reliable dehumidification

Crawlspace Dehumidifier for Up to 1,000 Sq Ft – This 70-pint commercial-grade unit removes moisture reliably: 35 pints/day AHAM, 70 pints saturation. Ideal for crawl spaces, basements, and similar-sized areas. Features a continuous drainage system with hose for automatic operation that requires little oversight. A dependable moisture control solution for crawl space and business settings

High-Performance Condensate Pump– This basement dehumidifier comes with a drain hose that solves distance drainage challenges. The included water pipe extends 19.6 feet. When installed in a home dehumidifier, the condensate pump can push water up to 19.6 feet in height. Whether you need gravity drainage or upward pumping, this AlorAir dehumidifier handles both. A reliable choice for wet rooms and spaces

Automatic Defrost: Our advanced auto-defrosting system continuously monitors the ambient temperature using built-in sensors. When the temperature is detected to be low, the unit initiates an automatic defrost cycle to prevent frost buildup and related issues. During this process, the compressor temporarily stops while the fan continues to operate, allowing the frost to thaw. Once the defrost cycle is complete, the dehumidifier resumes normal operation. This feature conserves energy and helps extend the lifespan of the unit

6-Year Limited Warranty & ETL Listed: This AlorAir crawl space dehumidifier is ETL listed for safety, backed by 6-year limited warranty - first 2 years full coverage with professional customer support ready to help whenever you need it
